facts.text: Shouxihu is a scenic lake in Hanjiang District, central Yangzhou, developed from Tang-era city moats; Qing salt merchants built estates along its banks
National AAAAA scenic area that requires a ticket; very slim lake winding through park just northwest of the city centre with several pavilions, designed to mimic West Lake in Hangzhou
2018 city price cut: 100 yuan peak (Mar-May, Sep-Nov), 60 yuan Feb and Jun-Aug, 30 yuan Dec-Jan

facts.text: Garden on Dongguan Street in Yangzhou, renovated by salt merchant Huang Zhiyun in the Qing dynasty from the Ming Shouzhi Garden, known for bamboo and stone design
Wikivoyage: garden with sections representing the four seasons and with pavilions
Tickets 45 yuan Mar-Jun and Sep-Dec, 30 yuan Jul-Aug and Jan-Feb

facts.text: He Garden (Jixiao Villa) on Xuningmen Street is the best-known private garden of late Qing Yangzhou, a state-protected heritage site and national AAAA attraction
Wikivoyage: scholar's garden with several tea houses, open grottoes and pleasant views
Tickets 45 yuan Mar-Jun and Sep-Dec, 30 yuan Jul-Aug and Jan-Feb

facts.text: Temple on the middle peak of Shugang Mountain, Yangzhou, known for monk Jianzhen who gave monastic ordination there in 742 AD before going to Japan

Tickets 45 yuan Mar-May and Sep-Nov, 20 yuan Jun-Aug and Dec-Feb
